title: Renewal-ready session slate and checklist (standard + enterprise)
body:
Purpose: provide a lightweight, reproducible QBR deck template (two linked variants: Standard customer and Enterprise customer) plus a one-page renewal tracker and a facilitation checklist. This doc is a living doc — intended for CSMs prepping renewal conversations where adoption + contract outcome are the priorities.

Status: rough draft. Use, adapt, give feedback. Sections below: pre-reads, slide-by-slide slate (standard), slide-by-slide slate (enterprise variation), one-page renewal tracker (fields + example), facilitation checklist, data pulls & SQL hints, open questions / TODOs.

1) Quick overview (one-line)
- Standard variant: 30-45m customer-facing session focused on adoption, wins, and next 90 days. Renewal ask reserved for end of meeting.
- Enterprise variant: 45-75m working session with technical and procurement stakeholders; includes risk mitigation, roadmap alignment, and proposed commercial terms.

2) Pre-reads (send 3 business days before)
- 1-pager: Account snapshot (ARR, renewal date, committed capacity, usage trend summary)
- Top 5 adoption metrics with short commentary (last 90d)
- Current open SRs/Troubleshooting list with owner and ETA

3) Slide-by-slide slate: Standard (recommended ~10 slides)
- Cover / Title: account, date, CSM, objectives (3 bullets)
- Agenda + Desired outcomes: state what a successful meeting looks like (decision/ask)
- Executive snapshot (1 slide): ARR, renewal date, health score, ROI highlight (single stat)
- Adoption highlights (2 slides): key features used, power users, top 3 product moments (screenshots or charts)
- Value stories (1-2 slides): short customer quotes, support wins, case example of time/cost saved
- Usage & cost efficiency (1 slide): token/usage KPIs, anomalies, saving opportunities (if applicable)
- Risks & open items (1 slide): top 3 risks + mitigation owners and ETA -> link to tracker
- Renewal posture & proposed options (1 slide): recommended path (renew, expand, renegotiate), 2 simple commercial options (base + uplift)
- Next steps & decision table (1 slide): concrete asks, owners, timelines
- Appendix/backup: enable Q&A, technical deep dives, contract excerpts

Speaker notes: for each slide include one sentence on "why this matters" and one recommended CSM prompt to surface alignment. Example: Executive snapshot -> "Why: focus exec time on single number that matters (ROI or ARR at-risk). Prompt: \"Does this reflect the metrics your execs care about today?\""

4) Slide-by-slide slate: Enterprise variation (adds depth + stakeholders)
- Keep Core Standard flow but expand:
  - Add a dedicated Security & Compliance slide (certs, data flows, KMS/HSM posture)
  - Add Detailed SLA & Performance history slide (p95 latency, outages, incident blurbs)
  - Add a Roadmap & Integration alignment slide (planned feature dates + integration impacts)
  - Expand Renewal posture slide to include transition/exit clauses, entitlements, and suggested SOW/commit timelines
  - Add Decision RACI slide to clarify procurement, legal, technical approvers and sign-off cadence

5) One-page renewal tracker (fields + sample)
- Fields (single-line): Account name | CSM | Renewal date | ARR | Commit tier | Current health score | Top risk | Renewal ask (Y/N) | Proposed value differential (USD) | Negotiation stage | Next meeting date | Owner | Last touch notes
- Example line: "Acme Corp | Aisha P. | 2026-06-12 | $280k | Standard | 72 | low adoption in X module | expand + 10% uplift | $28k | pricing discussion | 2026-03-15 | Marco R. | awaiting finance confirmation"

6) Facilitation checklist (for CSM before the meeting)
- Confirm sponsor and attendees (get titles)
- Data refresh: last 7/30/90 day metrics loaded into deck (scripts run)
- Attach relevant tickets (top 3) and pre-reads uploaded to meeting invite
- Prepare renewal options spreadsheet (3line items: base, commit, expansion)
- Run internal pre-call (15m) with AM/sales/solutions if > $200k ARR
- Red-team: identify top 2 objections + short scripts for each (2 lines each)

7) Data pulls & SQL hints (quick copy-paste)
- Active seats last 30d: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE account_id = {acct} AND ts > now() - interval '30 days';
- Messages generated by account over 90d: SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM generations WHERE account_id = {acct} AND ts > now() - interval '90 days';
- Top 5 features by usage: SELECT feature_name, COUNT(1) FROM feature_events WHERE account_id = {acct} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;

8) Renewal conversation scripts (short)
- Health-first opener: "Thanks — short recap: last quarter we saw X, Y, Z improvements. We'd like to propose next phase to lock in those gains. How does that sound from your side?"
- Procurement nudge: "We want to make renewal as frictionless as possible — two contractual options: 12-month with standard terms or 24-month with additional capacity and a 6% discount. Which do you prefer to explore?"

9) Appendix: artifacts to attach to final meeting notes
- Contract excerpt (current subscription), latest SOW drafts, support case list, technical runbook for integration owners

10) Open questions / TODOs
- Do we need a separate succinct version for SMB (<$25k ARR)? (TODO: create 6-slide micro deck)
- Can solutions-engineering produce a one-slide performance stamp for enterprise customers? (Assigned: David Kim)
- Finalize slide templates in Google Slides and add to shared template library (link to be added)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider a short animated gif to visualize daily active users growth (simple sparkline)
- Embed 1-click action buttons in slide for CSM to send contract link post-meeting (follow-up automation)

Links & references:

Contact: Aisha Patel (CSM lead) — comments welcome.

End of doc.
